head: Samsung Galaxy Studio headphones leak: India approval, features in code
dek: Samsung's unannounced over-ear headphones, model SM-U700 and believed to be called Galaxy Studio, got India's BIS approval on 20 November, after FCC, Korean and TUV approvals, TalkAndroid reports. Samsung hasn't confirmed them, a name or a launch date.
details: Code in the One UI 9.5 beta, found by SammyGuru, points to noise cancelling, an ambient mode, 360 Audio with head tracking, an 870 mAh battery, wired listening over USB-C and 3.5 mm, wear detection, multipoint, Auracast and Find support. Samsung filed a US trademark for "Galaxy Studio" in September. Reports point to a January 2027 Unpacked next to the Galaxy S27, which is unconfirmed. No price has leaked.
where: Not announced; certified in India, the US and South Korea
means: If you want Samsung over-ear headphones to go with a Galaxy phone, a launch may be close, but nothing is official yet.
todo: Nothing to do yet. Wait for Samsung's announcement and price before you buy other headphones just for this.
